caption: A ball bounces on a sunny court, and its shadow on the ground meets the ball at each bounce and separates as it rises.

sa.check: A ball bounces on a sunny court.
Its shadow on the ground meets the ball at each bounce.
The shadow separates from the ball as it rises.
The shadow stays on the ground throughout.

pc.expect: The shadow stays on the ground under the ball's path, and the ball touches its shadow only at each bounce.
pc.fail: The shadow rises with the ball; or the two swap places; or the shadow is missing in flight.

pc.expect: Each bounce is lower than the last and the ball comes down each time.
pc.fail: A bounce is higher than the one before; or the ball hangs; or it bounces sideways off flat ground.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the ball's round outline.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or streaks.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or switches sides during the bounces; or it is missing in sunlight.
A second ball or shadow appears; or the ball vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the court stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the court lines shift.
